arguments.cmd:
cd /work && python - <<'EOF'
# The part-level box covers the peg at part coords; the assembly-level v10 zone is the same
# faces shifted by (x1, y_c, gear_z). Undo the base-part edit, keep only the assembly one.
src = open('model.scad').read()
added = '''
            ["crank peg base fillet lip in place", [[x1 + 2.5, y_c + 2.5, 11.1 - 0.4], [x1 + 9.5, y_c + 9.5, 11.1 + 0.4]]]'''
print("count:", src.count(added))
# remove first occurrence (base part, line ~192), keep assembly one (line ~339)
i = src.find(added)
src = src[:i] + src[i+len(added):]
open('model.scad','w').write(src)
print("removed base-part copy")
EOF
grep -n "crank peg base fillet" /work/model.scad
